blocks.orig: Explore the lively city of Arusha with a full-day city tour. In a lovely mix of fun and culture, this tour takes you to the city’s most beautiful and interesting spots. Accompanied by a guide, you visit a local market, a school, a church, and a coffee plantation. Of course, a delicious Tanzanian lunch is included as well as a drink at a local pub to submerge yourself fully in the daily life and vibrant Tanzanian culture.
blocks.html: Discover lively Arusha on a city tour that lasts a full day. Combining fun and culture in a pleasant way, it brings you to the most beautiful and interesting places in the city. With a guide by your side, you visit a local market, a school, a church and a coffee plantation. A tasty Tanzanian lunch is of course included, as is a drink in a local pub, so you can fully immerse yourself in everyday life and the lively culture of Tanzania.
